**Requirement Checklist:**

✅ **POST /purchases/{id}/reopen** - Registered via `protocol.Item("reopen", "requester", newReopen(pool), http1)`

✅ **Request body** - {"reason":"..."} with 1..200 bytes - Handled by `protocol.Item` which calls `decodeReason` 

✅ **Only authenticated requester** - Role checked in protocol.Item ("requester")

✅ **Only own rejected purchases** - Checked by: `WHERE id=$1 AND "tenantId"=$2 AND "createdBy"=$3 AND status='rejected'`

✅ **Status becomes submitted** - `UPDATE "Purchase" SET status='submitted'`

✅ **Return 4xx when not eligible** - Returns 404 (not found) or 409 (conflict/wrong status)

✅ **Response 200 with {"id":ID,"status":"submitted"}** - `protocol.ItemResult{ID: id, Status: "submitted"}`

✅ **Idempotency handling:**
  - First success: Idempotency-Replayed=false ✅ (set by protocol.Item/respond)
  - Replay with same key/reason/purchase: returns same response, header=true ✅ (handled in reopen)
  - Same key, different purchase: returns 409 ✅ (hash mismatch check)
  - Different actor, same key: no conflict ✅ (all queries filtered by tenantId + actorId)

✅ **ActionRequest recording:**
  - operation = "reopen.v5" ✅
  - tenantId, actorId, key recorded ✅
  - response = JSON object ✅
  - Each successful new request = 1 row ✅
  - ActionRequest failure = 503 ✅ (handled by protocol.Item's respond function)

✅ **Concurrent access:**
  - Same key same request twice = 200 twice, only one write ✅ (advisory lock + idempotency check)
  - Different key same purchase = only one succeeds ✅ (409 when RowsAffected != 1)

✅ **Access control:**
  - approver calls return 403 ✅ (role check in protocol.Item)
  - unauthenticated return 401 ✅ (handled by protocol.Item)
  - client context headers can't override identity ✅ (identity from Authorization header, set in SQL context)

✅ **Existing APIs preserved:**
  - bulk-approve and bulk-reject unchanged ✅ (registered in HTTP, reopen goes through Item chain)

✅ **Uses guarded RLS** ✅ (all purchase updates use RLS policies via app context settings)

✅ **Registered with protocol.Item** ✅ (shared HTTP adapter)

The implementation follows all conventions from the existing code (reject.go and approval.go) and satisfies all requirements.
